title: Flying Domestic in NZ with Kids — Air NZ Tips, Baggage, and Seat Selection
meta_desc: Flying domestic in NZ with kids? Learn Air NZ tips, baggage allowance, and seat selection to make your family trip smoother
intro: As a parent, flying domestic in NZ with kids can be a daunting task, especially when it comes to navigating Air NZ's baggage allowance and seat selection. With prices starting from $59 NZD for a one-way ticket from Auckland to Wellington, it's essential to plan ahead to ensure a stress-free journey. In this article, we'll share our top tips for flying domestic in NZ with kids.

sections.heading: Air NZ Domestic Flights with Kids
sections.body: Air NZ offers a range of domestic flights across NZ, including popular routes such as Auckland to Queenstown, Christchurch to Wellington, and Auckland to Christchurch. With a flight time of approximately 1 hour and 20 minutes from Auckland to Queenstown, and 1 hour and 25 minutes from Christchurch to Wellington, these routes are ideal for families with young children.

sections.heading: Family Seating on Air NZ Domestic Flights
list: Book seats together: Air NZ offers a range of seating options, including family-friendly configurations such as 2-2 or 3-3 seating arrangements.
Consider the 'Skycouch': Air NZ's innovative 'Skycouch' seating option allows families to create a flat bed for young children, perfect for long-haul domestic flights.
Be mindful of exit rows: When booking seats, be aware that exit rows may not be suitable for families with young children due to safety regulations.

sections.heading: Baggage Allowance on Air NZ Domestic Flights
sections.body: Air NZ's baggage allowance for domestic flights is 1 piece of checked luggage per passenger, with a maximum weight of 23kg. Additional bags can be checked for a fee of $20-$30 NZD per piece. It's also worth noting that Air NZ offers a range of baggage options, including a 'Flexi' fare which includes an additional piece of checked luggage.

sections.heading: Tips for Flying with Young Children
list: Book a morning flight: Morning flights tend to be less busy, making them ideal for families with young children.
Pack entertainment: Bring along a range of toys, games, and snacks to keep your little ones occupied during the flight.
Consider a 'baby bundle': Air NZ offers a 'baby bundle' which includes a range of essentials such as nappies, wipes, and a changing pad.
